why: Perseverance's delta-front campaign at Jezero (sites 22-33, sols ~409-715): Hawksbill Gap, Wildcat Ridge, the Three Forks sample depot and the climb onto the delta top all fall inside this 2 km square; the scarp gives ~60 m of relief and thousands of Mastcam-Z/Navcam images were taken here.
source: Rover positions from NASA/JPL MMGIS waypoints, https://mars.nasa.gov/mmgis-maps/M20/Layers/json/M20_waypoints.json
